reported_context.timing: Completed the planned indoor session in the morning before a 10:30 meeting rather than in the afternoon.

pre_session_food.description: One slice of bread with peanut butter and honey plus whey protein isolate providing 24 g protein.
pre_session_food.estimate_guardrail: Bread size and peanut-butter and honey quantities were not reported, so no single carbohydrate total is asserted.

reported_context.garmin_sync: Athlete reported Garmin synced; live decision refresh completed at 09:41 local.

session_contract_review.heart_rate_drift: No meaningful stable-state drift: minutes 10-25 averaged 122.5 W and 132.5 bpm; minutes 25-40 averaged 122.3 W and 132.7 bpm, for approximately 0.36 percent efficiency-factor loss.

power_execution.minutes_0_to_10: 124.2 W average, above the written 95-110 W warm-up range
power_execution.minutes_10_to_40: approximately 122.4 W average, inside the 115-125 W full-branch range
power_execution.minutes_40_to_45: 99.1 W average, inside the 90-105 W cooldown range

session_contract_review.action_alignment_notes: Modality, one-session count, total duration, main-set power, cooldown, RPE and hard cap matched. The first 10 minutes averaged 124.2 W rather than the written progressive 95-110 W warm-up, so the delivered phase structure was not the nominal schema-v3 action.
session_contract_review.load_alignment: Garmin load 41.3 versus predicted 26.2 and range 18.4-35.4; actual was 16.7 percent above the upper bound and 57.6 percent above the point estimate.

fit_validation.known_pre_session_saddle_position: 12 mm aft relative to the pre-2026-08-10 setting.
fit_validation.trainer_pitch_interpretation: The front axle is higher, so the trainer setup is mildly nose-up rather than nose-down. A nose-down trainer bias does not explain the prior hand pressure.
fit_validation.knee_pedal_screen: Athlete reports an approximately vertical plumb line from the knee to the pedal axle with the non-drive-side crank at 9 o'clock.
fit_validation.knee_pedal_guardrail: This is a two-dimensional fit screen, not an independent prescription or proof of optimal setback.

coach_interpretation.verdict: The aerobic execution was controlled and stable, and the light pre-session meal was adequate. The higher-than-predicted Garmin load requires next-day review but is not evidence of physiological strain by itself because RPE was 2, power was steady and stable-state HR did not drift.
coach_interpretation.nutrition: The pre-session intake likely supplied approximately 20-40 g carbohydrate and at least 24 g protein. No during-session carbohydrate was required for this 45-minute easy dose.
coach_interpretation.thursday_constraint: Thursday MTB is neither cleared nor cancelled by this result. Fresh Thursday sleep/readiness/CNS evidence plus leg and fit response remain required.
